rules.claim: GameControl.LoadGameScene requests EntityModelConfig ID11001, which maps to GameScene/HD4_CJ_1. Source SceneSkinConfig prefabId12001 is unused by the compiled path; it is absent from compiled SceneSkinConfig fields.

GameControl helper7818 indexes SceneSkinConfig and reads instance+24=gameIconName, then LoadTexture; helper15169 Sprite.Create full texture rect with pivot .5,.5 and PPU100, SpriteRenderer.set_sprite. For skin1 texture is scene_skin_game1; not the shop preview tubiao01.
Helper5063 optionally loads SceneEffectConfig.gameEffect for active skin. Only skins7/8/9 have rows; skin1 has no extra effect.

unknowns.detail: Static chain validates selected source texture. Reported reconstructed horizontal stripes require checking decoded texture and camera/geometry/renderer state against original live reference, not selecting an invented replacement.
